parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: The table shows the structural formulae of four compounds, **A**, **B**, **C** and **D**, with molecular formula $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8$.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
Complete the table by giving the systematic name of **A**, **B**, **C** and **D**.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: **W** is an alkene with formula $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8$. It reacts with $\text{HBr}$ to form two possible carbocations, $\text{CH}_3\text{C}^+(\text{H})(\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3)$ and $\text{H}_2\text{C}^+\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the skeletal formula of the major organic product formed when $\text{HBr}$ reacts with **W**. Explain why this is the major organic product.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A sample of propan-1-ol reacts with concentrated sulfuric acid to form propene.

Identify the role of concentrated sulfuric acid in this reaction.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem:
Alcohol **Y** reacts completely when warmed with acidified $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}$ to form **Z**.

**Z** is distilled from the reaction mixture as soon as it is made.

Tollens' reagent is added to a sample of **Z** and warmed. A silver mirror forms.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction that occurs when **Y** reacts to form **Z**.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
Identify with a tick ($\checkmark$) the functional group(s) present in **Z**.

| functional group | present in **Z** |
| :--- | :--- |
| aldehyde |  |
| ketone |  |
| carboxylic acid |  |
